summary: Small gain over w9 (7.9). Fixed: the E comforter now reads as box-quilted (r10 shows a clear ~0.33 m grid; tpg_72). The pillow checks are near the right scale (~14 checks across the short side, against ~13 in omaat_room_15). The slipper pouch is a soft rounded navy shape. The O footwell stops short of E's table wall. The far-LOD screen sits at 0.8725. The monument top now splits into two housings by a spine with a metal rail: in r3 it reads as two housings, in q09 it is a 5 cm rib on a still-broad flat charcoal top. Still wrong when held against real photos: (1) In c_27313 / c_27315 the housing tops carry wide light grey-metal edges (#969b9e); the render's housing tops are uniform blue-charcoal #6f7682, so from the aisle the monument is still a dark beam. (2) The O comforter (r9) still reads as crumpled satin; its quilt line is barely visible. (3) The pillow pattern is a soft blurred houndstooth/plus, not crisp two-tone ichimatsu squares. In the studio the pillow comes out as pale periwinkle about as light as the seat (Y ratio 0.97), whereas in omaat_room_15 the pillow is clearly darker than the seat (0.76). In the cabin (q09 #384493 against seat #4a525e) the ratio is right, so this is mostly the studio light. (4) The pad still renders a neutral near-white (#f2f0eb against tpg_72 #e7dac7). (5) The E mattress overlap went from 2 cm to 4 cm, contradicting the w9b commit message. The seated pair (layout, shells, consoles, monitor wall, ash tables, plaques) is clearly the same product as c_27312/13/15/16. The remaining mismatches are soft goods and the monument-top finish.

issues.detail: Monument housing tops are uniform charcoal; the photos show light grey-metal edges
issues.problem: From the aisle (q09, q10) the monument still reads as one broad dark beam with a thin rib. In c_27313 the tops of the O and E housings either side of the spine are light metal grey (#969b9e / #8c999f against shell walls #434954), and c_27315 shows ~3-4 cm light edge bands framing each housing's back face.
issues.fix: In roomPart('O') after line 439, add a jPanelEdge (or { c: '#9a9ea2', r: 0.3, m: 0.5, l: LAYER.brushed }) top band on each housing: for (const s of [-1, 1]) B.add(gRBox(1.13, 0.006, 0.06, 0.003, 1), M4.trs(-0.02, MON.top + 0.003, mz + s * 0.07), rail), plus a 0.012-wide edge strip on the outer top edges at MON.zO / MON.zE (gRBox(1.13, 0.012, 0.012, 0.004, 1) at z = MON.zO + 0.006 and MON.zE - 0.006). Keep the centre spine charcoal so it reads as a dark fin between two light rims.

issues.problem: The E bed reads as quilted, the O bed does not: the O folds [-0.10,-0.30,35,0.60,0.04] and [0.12,0.05,-30,0.50,0.034] fall across the visible O sheet, and the O grid phase (gx = x - xc + 0.07, xc -0.12) puts a stitch line close to the sheet edge, so only one interior line is visible.
issues.evidence: r9 crop: one faint stitch cross; r10 clear grid; tpg_72 shows the stitches as the dominant feature.
issues.fix: In duvetSheet, scale the folds by 0.35 instead of 0.5 (line 305), or pass a per-part fold gain (O 0.3). Set the grid phase so that two stitch lines cross the O sheet: gx = x - xc - 0.05 for hd > 0. Optionally deepen the dip to 0.024 * exp(-(dq/0.018)^2) for a crisper seam.

issues.detail: Pillow jacquard is a blurred plus/houndstooth, not crisp two-tone ichimatsu
issues.problem: omaat_room_15 shows sharp-edged squares in two blues with a slow diagonal light/dark banding. The render's pattern has soft plus-shaped blobs, and the rim is light cream where the photo flange is mauve-grey (#b6abad).
issues.evidence: r7 crop 250-460 x 240-450 against omaat_room_15 crop 600-960 x 420-800.
issues.fix: LAYER_PARAMS 9 in 03_tex.js (shared, one line): use a hard step instead of the smooth check, e.g. checker = step(0.5, fract(u*k)) xor step(0.5, fract(v*k)) with contrast ~0.18, and add a low-frequency diagonal band sin((u+v)*k/6). In roomPillow the flange uses SEATMAT.jPillowBack; check that it renders mid mauve-grey (~#9a9295) rather than cream.

issues.detail: Pillow too light and periwinkle relative to the seat under studio light
issues.problem: In omaat_room_15 the pillow is clearly darker than the seat fabric (luma ratio 0.76, hue violet-navy #5a5f98). In r7 it is 0.97 and periwinkle #8f9ddc. In the cabin (q09) the ratio is fine, so this may be studio exposure only.
issues.evidence: r7 pillow #8f9ddc against seat #a8a3ab; omaat_room_15 pillow #5a5f98 against seat #847f7f; q09 pillow #384493 against seat #4a525e.
issues.fix: If the pillow still reads light after lighting work, set SEATMAT.pillowBlue c to '#454c8c' (09_seats.js, shared, one line). No 09c change.

issues.problem: #d9cfbc renders as #f2f0eb in r9, the same tone as the white pillow, whereas tpg_72's pad is warmer and darker than its pillow.
issues.evidence: r9 pad #f2f0eb, white pillow #f7f7f6; tpg_72 pad #e7dac7, pillow #f1dfc9.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.mattress c '#cfc2aa' (shared, one line), or give the white pillow '#f1efe9' so the pad reads warmer by contrast.

issues.detail: E mattress pieces overlap by 4 cm (regressed from 2 cm); O pieces overlap by 2 cm
issues.problem: Line 371 mat(-0.035, 0.495, MON.zE - 0.02, 0.66) and mat(-0.118, 0.495, 0.62, 1.28) overlap over z 0.62-0.66 with coplanar tops (risk of z-fight and a crease). Line 364 O pieces overlap over -0.64..-0.62. The w9b commit message says the pieces no longer overlap.
issues.fix: E: end the first piece at 0.62 and start the second at 0.62 (butt joint), or keep the overlap and drop the second piece by 0.002 (y + 0.018) so the tops are not coplanar. O: end piece 1 at -0.64, or lower piece 2 by 0.002.

issues.problem: In tpg_72 the comforter carries the same faint check jacquard as the pillow. The render's comforter is plain satin.
issues.evidence: tpg_72 comforter centre (500-700, 280-380) shows faint checks; r9/r10 are plain.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.duvet l: LAYER.pillowCheck-equivalent at half contrast (shared 09_seats.js), or in roomBed pass a duvet material { ...SEATMAT.duvet, l: <check layer> } with the UVs already emitted by duvetSheet (scale them so one check is ~2.3 cm: g.u.push(i/nu*W/0.023 ...)).
